quotes.title: Kepler-6
quotes.card: Kepler-6 is a G-type star situated in the constellation Cygnus.
quotes.introduction: The star lies within the field of view of the Kepler Mission, which discovered it as part of a NASA-led mission to discover Earth-like planets.
